description: This PHP file defines the InterestRate class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Financial namespace. The class provides methods to compute effective and nominal interest rates based on input parameters, likely used as part of a spreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: InterestRate
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate effective and nominal interest rates, used within spreadsheet financial calculations.

methods.name: effective
methods.description: Calculates the effective interest rate given a nominal rate and number of compounding periods per year.

methods.name: nominal
methods.description: Calculates the nominal interest rate based on an effective rate and number of compounding periods per year.
